scenes.name: the globe to one browser window
WordPress runs on PHP: two bugs
the key left in the tiffin
the PHP server is the same: match cut
the hacker walks past the login
ask your host: the safe versions

sfx.note: pure black: a low sub drone fades in from silence
the calendar dissolves into the globe
rising alarm pad: peaks as every server flashes red
udd gayi: all servers flash red, red pulse ring, 2-frame shake
the globe zooms past the camera (dolly through)
the browser window is there (address bar writes on)
the WordPress pill springs in on the word
second 'aapki': push-in + one red outline pulse
the window lifts like an X-ray: the PHP layer is revealed (sound peaks here)
the connector lands: big PHP appears in the glass panel
bug 1 crawls out of the lower-left corner
bug 2 crawls out of the lower-right corner
tape-like reverse riser under 'das saal se chupchaap baithe the': its END lands on 'the', where the idea ends
the lens sweeps across the panel and locks into focus (swoosh ends with its tiny lock)
'pakda': the lens stops, the bugs freeze inside it
a small sparkle on the lens
everything dissolves to dust, drifting up and out
dots drift in: first note of the curious motif
the figure's head and cap are drawn
dabbawala: the cap fills white, the pill springs in
tiffin: a round tiffin on every roof
a tiffin lands on house 4 (the long hop over the dabbawala, on "doosre")
a tiffin lands on house 1 (the last one, on the final "ghar")
tiffin: the curious motif answers (one note)
the tiffin lifts off house 5 and starts its trip back
chaabi: the lid opens slightly, X-ray: a red key inside
the tiffin lands on house 4's roof
kholta: the second person lifts the lid
the red key floats up (peak just before it lands)
haath: the key lands in his hand, eyes widen, red !
the data-flow hum begins under the match cut
server: the houses grow into server racks (peak as they stand)
pill TIFFIN -> REQUEST (the tiffins become envelopes)
pill BACHA HUA DATA -> MEMORY (red bits appear in rack 2)
agle: the red bits lift out of rack 2
the envelope leaves the server along the request line
the hum under the leak and the chips (cut before S8)
PASSWORD bursts out of the envelope (glitch flicker)
the login box writes on in front of the racks
sneaking: footfall 0 (the figure is at x~134)
sneaking: footfall 1 (the figure is at x~380)
kiye: the red strike-through wipes across the login box
sneaking: footfall 2 (the figure is at x~646)
sneaking: footfall 3 (the figure is at x~800)
control: big low hit, micro-shake, push-in
control: the red wave rises through every rack, bottom to top
the cursor clicks: a ring leaves its tip
the red hall dissolves into dust
the gauge arc writes on (from the dust of S8)
9.2: the needle peaks past 9.2: heavy clunk, micro-shake, the number pops
the red CRITICAL pill springs in
fix: the green shield fills, its check writes on
attack arrow 1 bounces off the shield
attack arrow 2 bounces off the shield
attack arrow 3 bounces off the shield
attack arrow 4 bounces off the shield
sach: the single soft piano note: the only sound here
card 1 lands: No confirmed major breach (as of 21 Oct)
card 2 lands: Some services offline as a precaution
fix aa chuka hai: the green check writes on, the warm resolved chord
the chat bubble appears (it writes on across 'ek sawaal')
the message is sent; the panel starts to slide up
line 1 ticks in with its green check
line 2 ticks in with its green check
line 3 ticks in with its green check
line 4 ticks in with its green check
the hold starts: screenshot cue, a soft flash runs round the panel's edge
the left card ('Plugin update') lands on 'update'
the right card ('PHP update + server restart') lands
'nahi': the red X lands on the plugin card
'PHP': the green check lands on the PHP card
'khud': the PHP card scales up to 1.08 and the plugin card dims
the scene opens: an upbeat pluck resolves
the little envelope icon writes on
the paper plane flies from the pill to the friend (the sound sweeps left to right)
'bhejo': the plane lands on the friend, a ripple
'website': the browser window above his head
the last word: @baqur.ai glows; the gentle final chime
